Host an Event at Lucas Oil Stadium Host your next private or corporate event at Lucas Oil Stadium, a unique backdrop for your special occasion and one that cannot be replicated. Imagine your guests’ surprise and delight when they enter another realm of exhilaration and enjoy the fabulous tastes, sights and sounds of this one-of-a-kind venue. For more information, please contact Mikayla Holcomb Booking Manager (317) 262-2532 lossales@icclos.com Lucas Oil Stadium 500 S.
